title: Interchange Qualification & Least-Cost Routing Rule Builder
description: Deterministic interchange qualification engine mapping card transaction attributes to Visa/Mastercard interchange tiers using publicly published schedules. Identifies downgrade risks, builds a prioritised LCR routing rule set (Durbin/RBA regulated debit → L3 commercial → L2 commercial → 3DS2 consumer → default), generates a Level 2/3 data field eligibility matrix, and computes portfolio-level interchange savings estimates. AP2 JSON routing_policy_mandate export. Client-side. Zero PII. Uses publicly published interchange schedules — review annually each April.
review_frequency: annual — interchange schedules updated each April
schedule_source: Visa US Interchange Reimbursement Fees April 2025 (publicly published); Mastercard US Interchange Rates April 2025 (publicly published)

monthly_cnp_volume.description: Monthly CNP processing volume in USD/EUR

lcr_routing_rules.description: Ordered rules — apply first matching rule at authorisation gateway

mcp_tool_definition.name: build_interchange_qualification_ruleset
mcp_tool_definition.description: Map card transaction attributes to Visa/Mastercard interchange qualification tiers using publicly published schedules. Identifies downgrade risks (missing 3DS2, no CVV2, commercial card without L2/L3 data, late settlement). Builds a prioritised LCR routing rule set actionable in a payment gateway (Durbin-regulated debit first → L3 commercial → L2 commercial → 3DS2-qualified consumer → default). Generates L2/L3 field requirements matrix per card type. Computes portfolio-level interchange savings estimate across LCR, L2/L3, 3DS2 adoption, and downgrade reduction. Note: interchange schedules are updated annually — check last_reviewed date before relying on tier names and rates. Use when a merchant, PayFac, or acquirer ISO needs to optimise card acceptance costs or configure gateway routing.
